import heapq

class MedianFinder:
    def __init__(self):
        # Max-heap for the lower half of the numbers
        self.lower = []
        # Min-heap for the upper half of the numbers
        self.upper = []

    def add_num(self, num: int) -> None:
        # Add to max-heap by pushing negative value
        heapq.heappush(self.lower, -num)
        
        # Balance heaps if necessary
        if len(self.lower) > len(self.upper) + 1:
            heapq.heappush(self.upper, -heapq.heappop(self.lower))
        
        # Ensure min-heap is not larger than max-heap
        if self.upper and -self.lower[0] > self.upper[0]:
            heapq.heappush(self.lower, -heapq.heappop(self.upper))

    def find_median(self) -> float:
        if len(self.lower) == len(self.upper):
            return (-self.lower[0] + self.upper[0]) / 2.0
        else:
            return -self.lower[0]

# Test cases
def test_median_finder():
    mf = MedianFinder()
    mf.add_num(1)
    assert mf.find_median() == 1.0, f"Expected 1.0, got {mf.find_median()}"
    
    mf.add_num(2)

    mf.add_num(5)
    assert mf.find_median() == 3.0, f"Expected 3.0, got {mf.find_median()}"

test_median_finder()
print("All tests passed!")
